platform_responses: FitScore decay: scores drop 0.5 % per day of candidate inactivity. The counter resets when the candidate logs in or updates their profile, and a full re-compute kicks in via Agenda after 90 days.

For Mailgun simulations, JobNV validates the `X-Mailgun-Signature` and `timestamp` headers. NA10 reproduces them using the shared HMAC key stored in `na10.env`.
To mirror Innate Core for BI, use Postgres logical replication into a read-only replica. It keeps transactional load off the primary without extra tooling.
Custom React-Flow nodes: extend the `@envy/nv-flow-sdk`; no fork is required. See the “Custom Nodes” recipe in the Developer Guide.
CampusHub GraphQL supports cursor-based pagination (`after`, `first`) and is Relay-spec compatible.
On Apple-Silicon, pre-warm F-Nodes with `ENV_PRELOAD=1` to cut cold-start latency from ~450 ms to roughly 180 ms.
MongoDB handles unstructured candidate snapshots from third-party imports and offers TTL indexes we rely on for retention policies—those requirements tipped the scale over Postgres JSONB.
SmartMatch embeddings refresh daily at 02:00 cluster-local time; you can override the cron in `envy.config` if your scale model demands it.
